content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are notoriously restrictive, imposing their own rules and regulations on businesses operating in multiple countries. In Nigeria, the ban on crypto transactions by the Central Bank of Nigeria has left many creators without a payment solution. However, with Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments, you can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of these platforms. This means you have full control over your business, your data, and your payments, without relying on foreign entities that can restrict or freeze your accounts at any time.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start building your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to gather a few essential tools and resources. These include a domain name, a content management system like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery platform like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Additionally, you'll need to sign up for NOWPayments, a payment processor that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and offers a 0.5% fee for transactions.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The next step is to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. You'll also need to set up your file delivery platform to deliver products to customers instantly, using a secure and reliable system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, you'll need to configure your order storage solution to store customer information and order details securely.
Build a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments to avoid relying on foreign entities that can restrict or freeze your accounts at any time.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves setting up a test transaction to ensure that your payment and delivery pipeline is working correctly. You'll also need to configure your NOWPayments account to receive payments in the currency of your choice, such as naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, or Pakistani rupees. Finally, you'll need to test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working correctly and that customers can receive their products instantly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, you'll need to scale it to meet the demands of your growing business. This involves monitoring your traffic and adjusting your infrastructure accordingly. You may need to add more resources to your Cloudflare account, or upgrade your NOWPayments plan to handle more transactions. Additionally, you may need to optimize your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working efficiently and effectively.
